iWantTo: see a calm, scannable home table of stock by location showing SKU, location, and right-aligned quantity
soThat: I can read at a glance what is on the shelves across locations

independence.rationale: S1 delivers only the filing/write path and single-record retrieval; S2 adds the home screen that aggregates and renders all stock records as a scannable by-location table with an explicit 'No stock at this location' empty state. S1 can be fully built (records exist and are retrievable) with no home table or empty state screen present, so this list/overview view is genuinely unbuilt after S1.
